text:
Alex: quick midday async — release train status: canary traffic at 12% to v2.1.1, no user-facing errors so far.
Maria: rolling canary looks steady from my side, CPU p95 dipped a bit after the rollback to q8.
Sanjay: saw two 502s from the proxy ~10:12, stack traces point to transient connect timeout to embedding service. I restarted the pool and it recovered.
Jen: thanks. @Sanjay can you attach the restart command you ran? we should add to runbook if this recurs.
Sanjay: ran `kubectl rollout restart deploy/embeddings-pool -n inference-prod` and then `kubectl scale deploy/embeddings-pool --replicas=4`. both in cloud region-us-west2.
Carol: FYI I pushed a small backport for #4342 that fixes a race in KV cache invalidation — it’s lined up for cherry-pick to the release branch.
Alex: nice, can you link the PR?
Carol: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4342 — left a note about the test flake.
Leo: quick FYI, one of the canary nodes hit p99 token latency spike ~200ms during the embeddings reconnect. I swapped it out from the pool.
Maria: spike coincided with a GC event on that machine — we've seen this with x86 instances when batch size > 64. lowering batch to 48 for canary.
Jen: action items: 1) @Carol merge backport once CI passes, 2) @Sanjay add restart snippet to runbook, 3) @Maria monitor canary after batch change for 30m.
Alex: production deploy target still on for 18:00 UTC, unless we see repeat failures.
DeployBot: Canary rollout to v2.1.1 started at 1768887900, current traffic 12%, status: progressing.
Sanjay: also noted a flaky e2e failing in CI (tests/ui/restore-snapshot) — investigating root cause, might be unrelated but could block the backport merge. PR #4342 CI currently green except that pipeline.
Carol: WFM to re-run CI after I rebase — will trigger in ~10m.
Leo: small ask from QA — can we tag a subset of telemetry for the canary so they can filter traces? I can add a header `x-release-canary: v2.1.1` on canary requests.
Alex: yes please, add the header and notify QA.
Maria: monitoring note: bumped alert threshold for embeddings error rate from 0.5% to 1% while we stabilize, will revert after canary completes.
Jen: if no regressions by 17:45 UTC we proceed with broader rollout. If we see >1% errors or persistent p99 spikes, we hold and rollback.
Alex: blockers? anyone blocked on merges or approvals?
Carol: just waiting on one final approval from infra-sig, pinged them.
Sanjay: waiting on prod key rotation window to finish for a small infra PR — ETA 30m.
Maria: no blocking regs from my end.
Jen: thanks team — update this thread if anything changes, otherwise I’ll post final go/no-go at 17:50 UTC. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks, everyone.
